operations.name: STATIC_WEB_ABORT_CONTROLLER_TIMEOUT_FIX
operations.evidence: Added 7-second AbortController timeout for every JSON request.

operations.name: STATIC_WEB_BOUNDED_RETRY_FIX
operations.evidence: Added one bounded retry with short deterministic delay; no unbounded loop.

operations.name: STATIC_WEB_OPTIONAL_JSON_SAFE_FALLBACK_FIX

operations.name: STATIC_WEB_RUNTIME_ERROR_LEDGER_FIX

operations.name: STATIC_WEB_CRITICAL_PROGRESS_FILE_GATE

operations.name: STATIC_WEB_PARTIAL_RENDER_CONTINUATION_FIX
operations.evidence: Render now loads critical progress first and optional groups through safe concurrent loaders.

operations.name: STATIC_WEB_NO_INFINITE_PENDING_CONTRACT
operations.evidence: Every fetch has a finite timeout/retry ceiling; infinite pending contract removed.
